generator: Use the centered linear/quadratic pixel-coordinate phase and the per-direction PCG64 offset from evaluate_weave.new_cases, with the same offset for both strengths. Clip each observation to [0,1]. Carry exact amplitude in a separate CSV column. All eight new (fy,fx) pairs are in cycles/pixel.
clean_transforms: Rotate the original clockwise by 90 degrees; raise gray intensity to power 1.25; or bilinearly sample with reflect boundaries at (y+1.6*sin(2*pi*(x+0.23*y)/83), x+2.2*cos(2*pi*(y-0.17*x)/127)). Treat each transformed photograph as the clean reference and identical observation.
texture_metric: Reuse evaluate_weak83.measure and its six pairs of reference Fourier peak disks, real post-clipping gain, off_noise_mse, texture_excess_mse at matched gain, and total texture_band_mse versus clean. Zero exposure is evaluated by changed pixels and MAE.
scope: Nine known failures are regression/design cases. The sixteen new noisy conditions and three new controls reuse the same original photograph; directions and phase seeds are fixed before new samples or inference.
